page.title: 亚声威格亚马逊管理系统

bodySamples.sample:
<style>
    #sales_by_seller {
        padding: 20px;
    }

    .search_area {
        padding-top: 20px;
    }

    .table_btn_area {
        background: #f2f2f2;
        padding: 5px 20px;
    }

    .pagination_area {
        margin: 10px 0;
    }

    .flex {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
    }

    .flex-between {
        justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .text_btn {
        display: inline;
        color: #409eff;
        font-weight: 500;
        cursor: pointer;
    }

    .text_btn:hover {
        color: #66b1ff;
    }

    .icon_btn {
        cursor: pointer;
        user-select: none;
    }

    .icon_btn:hover {
        color: #409eff;
    }

    .none {
        display: none;
    }

    .columnGreen {
        background-color: #f0f9eb;
    }

    .solr_term_tree_select .el-select-dropdown__wrap {
        min-width: 400px;
    }

    .solr_term_tree_select .el-select-dropdown__wrap .el-tree {
        width: 100% !important;
        white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .filterItem {
        box-sizing: border-box;
        border: 1px solid #b3d8ff;
        color: #409eff;
        padding: 0 5px;
        margin: 2px;
        border-radius: 3px;
        cursor: pointer;
        user-select: none;
        line-height: 20px;
    }

    .filterItem:hover {
        border-color: #409eff;
    }

    .filterItem i.rotate {
        transform: rotate(-180deg);
    }

    .filterItem .filterIcon {
        padding: 2px;
        cursor: pointer;
    }

    .filterItem .filterIcon:hover {
        background: #409eff;
        color: #fff;
        border-radius: 10px;
    }
</style>
